title: Pure Spright
summary: Spright cards only, with generic Rank 2s, Link-2s and staples. Every Spright is a Level 2 Thunder that summons itself from the hand while you control a Level 2 or Rank 2 monster (Red and Carrot also count Link 2). Spright Blue searches another Spright monster, Spright Jet searches a Spright Spell/Trap, and Spright Starter summons one straight from the Deck. Gigantic Spright detaches to summon a Level 2 from the Deck. Spright Red and Spright Carrot tribute another Level/Rank/Link 2 monster to negate a monster or Spell/Trap effect, and destroy it if the tribute was a Rank or Link 2. Spright Sprind mills a Level 2, or detaches an Xyz material to bounce a monster when another monster is summoned. Spright Double Cross revives, steals or attaches a monster. Spright Elf is Forbidden. Spright Starter limits you to Level/Rank/Link 2 monsters.
